title: Partnerships/Marketplace — Daily Notes (Ashley)
content:
Daily scratchpad — Partnerships / Marketplace (Ashley)
Date: 2026-03-04

Top of mind / today
- 11:00 AM call w/ Acme AI (onboarding; API + billing alignment). Prep: demo flow, sandbox creds, SLO asks.
- Finish integration checklist and send to Eng & Legal before EOD Thu.
- Confirm Dedicated capacity pricing tier for Acme POC.

Quick notes from last sync (2026-03-03)
- Acme wants 500 qps peak for POC, but initial traffic expected ~50 qps. They care about 95th p99 latency <= 150ms for chat endpoint.
- Legal requested data flow diagram and data retention policy. Action: send Confluence link + brief paragraph by Thu.
- Eng flagged need for mutual TLS for private deploys; might be overkill for initial hosted POC.

Meeting agenda (11:00)
1) Quick intros (5m)
2) POC goals & success metrics (10m)
   - Throughput targets, latency SLOs, sample workloads
3) Integration plan (15m)
   - API endpoints, auth, sandbox creds, webhook usage
4) Billing & pricing expectations (10m)
5) Next steps & timeline (5m)

Action items (owner / due)
- Send integration checklist + sandbox instructions to Acme (Ashley) / 2026-03-04 EOD
- Create onboarding ticket for Eng (Jordan) / 2026-03-05
- Draft data flow + retention note for Legal (Samir) / 2026-03-05
- Validate Dedicated capacity quote and confirm discounts for POC (Maya) / 2026-03-06
- Prepare short demo (chat -> function call flow) and canned prompts for Acme to run (Ashley) / 2026-03-05

Integration checklist (working) — make sure we hit these before POC kickoff
- [ ] Sandbox API key created and limited to test models
- [ ] Sample payloads + sample user IDs provided
- [ ] Rate limits & spike protection documented (suggested: 100 qps default)
- [ ] Webhook retry/backoff guidelines (idempotency notes)
- [ ] Logging & observability: include request_id header and example traces
- [ ] Privacy: confirm what user data is sent, PII handling, and retention windows
- [ ] SLA: baseline SLOs for hosted vs dedicated, escalation path
- [ ] Billing: test invoice flow + expected trial credits applied
- [ ] Security: list of approved IP ranges or mutual TLS requirement
- [ ] Legal: NDA/DSA status, export controls if any

Notes / conversation fragments (informal)
- Acme devs curious about caching — explain prefix caching for chat to save tokens. Might reduce cost by ~20% for typical convo.
- They asked if we support server-side function calling. Yes — show demo.
- Concern: they want guaranteed region routing (EU). Need to verify hosted regions coverage and latency.

Blockers / risks
- Legal sign-off timeline could push POC start by 2 weeks. Plan: provide as much documentation as possible to speed review.
- Dedicated pricing approval (finance) might be slow for smaller partners. Consider a short-term hosted credit package for POC.

Things to follow up after call
- Send meeting notes + checklist (Ashley) — include Confluence link to integration doc.
- Open onboarding ticket in Linear/Jira and tag eng-sre + eng-serving-runtime (Jordan).
- Request short review from Prod Security on TLS vs IP allowlist (Samir).

Personal TODO (today)
- Update demo script w/ EU region baseline (10-30m)
- Draft email to Acme w/ sandbox creds + limited instructions (20m)
- Sync with Maya re: pricing (15m)
- Quick check with Eng on webhook idempotency patterns (5-10m)

Random notes / brainstorming
- Could offer a "POC starter pack": 2w free credits, 1 week of dedicated capacity at reduced rate, and a pre-filled integration checklist. Use for small partners to accelerate conversion.
- Consider short playbook for regional routing requests (FAQ + quicksteps).

Linked items / refs
- Confluence: Acme integration spec (link above)
- Jira: PRJ-4821 (onboarding epic)
- GH: partner-demos PR-18 contains the demo app; may need to trim EU config

Temp scratch / notes to self
- If legal requests DPA changes, get template from ops-legal@redwood (Maya usually helps)
- Check if analytics team can send 7d sample latency histogram for hosted eu-west-1 (ask eng-observability)

End of notes.
